# May Solutions

> May Solutions is a software development and IT consulting company based in Riedberg, Frankfurt am Main, Germany. It builds custom web platforms, online shops and AI / computer-vision features and advises on software architecture and on using AI effectively, for companies in Frankfurt, the Rhein-Main region and across Europe, in German and English. (Deutsch: Softwareentwicklung und IT-Beratung in Riedberg, Frankfurt am Main.)

## What May Solutions does

- Web development: web applications and online shops end to end (interface, API, database, delivery pipeline). Reference: frontend lead for the Mercedes-Benz online shop.
- IT consulting: system and software architecture design, reviews of architecture, code and delivery pipelines, and hands-on implementation alongside the client's team.
- AI, vision & speech: machine-learning, computer-vision and speech features taken into production, including object classification, speech-to-text, text-to-speech and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Reference: state-of-the-art AI for thinkcell.
- AI consulting: how to use frontier AI models effectively, in business and in daily work: use cases, model and tool selection, and applications built on Anthropic, OpenAI and Google Vertex AI models.
- Working mode: agile delivery, short iterations, working software early.

## Location and area served

- Headquarters: Riedberg, Frankfurt am Main, Hessen, Germany (the city's science district, home of the Goethe University campus).
- Serves: Frankfurt am Main, the Rhein-Main region, Germany and Europe.
- Languages: German, English.

## Clients

SOKA-BAU, Mercedes-Benz.io, LBBW, GitLab, Bilfinger, thinkcell.

## Technologies

TypeScript, Vue, React, Angular, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Spring Boot, Flask, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Google Cloud (GCP), AWS, Firebase, Supabase, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, Harbor, Grafana, Anthropic, OpenAI, Vertex AI, Langfuse, TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenCV, FFmpeg.
